scripts.land: node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts land start && vp run translate && vp run ci && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts land finish
scripts.promote: node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts promote check && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts cloudflare deploy && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts cloudflare docs-deploy && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts promote done
scripts.release: node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts release check && CHECK_LOCALES=all vp run ci && vp run release-checks && vp run publish:rehearse && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts test cwv && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts packages tag
scripts.setup: node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts setup check && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts setup install && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts skills install && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts rules && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts mcp register && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts hooks && node packages/ui/src/cli/remy.ts verify && vp run check
scripts.ui:components: shadcn add button card input label badge alert field separator direction skeleton empty sidebar breadcrumb collapsible dropdown-menu avatar sheet tooltip navigation-menu use-mobile table spinner tabs --overwrite --yes -c apps/remy-auth

scripts.ui:verify: vp run ui:theme && vp run ui:components && vp fmt packages/ui/src/components packages/ui/src/hooks packages/ui/src/styles apps/remy-auth/src/lib && git diff --exit-code -- packages/ui/src/components packages/ui/src/hooks packages/ui/src/styles apps/remy-auth/src/lib
